class Node:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.prev = None
        self.data = data
        self.next = None

class DoublyLinkedList:
    def __init__(self):
        self.head = None
        self.tail = None

    # 遍历链表
    def traverse(self):
        current = self.head
        print("None", end = " <-> ")
        while current is not None:
            print(f"{current.data} <-> ", end="") 
            current = current.next
        print("None")

    # 反向遍历链表
    def reverse_traverse(self):
        current = self.tail
        print("None", end = " <-> ")
        while current is not None:
            print(f"{current.data} <-> ", end="") 
            current = current.prev
        print("None")
    # 结点计数
    def node_count(self):
        current = self.head
        count = 0
        while current is not None:
            count += 1
            current = current.next
        return count

    # 检查是否为空
    def is_empty(self):
        return self.head == None

    # 追加到空链表
    def append_to_empty(self, data):
        new_node = Node(data)
        self.head = new_node
        self.tail = new_node

    # 在末尾插入（追加）
    def append(self, data):
        if self.is_empty():
            self.append_to_empty(data)
            return
        new_node = Node(data)
        new_node.prev = self.tail
        self.tail.next = new_node
        self.tail = new_node
    
    # 在开头插入
    def insert_at_beginning(self, data):
        if self.is_empty():
            self.append_to_empty()
            return
        new_node = Node(data)
        new_node.next = self.head
        self.head.prev = new_node
        self.head = new_node
    
    # 插入位置
    def insert_at_position(self, position, data):
        if position < 0 or position > self.node_count():
            print("Invalid position")
            return
        elif position == 0:
            self.insert_at_beginning(data)
            return
        elif position == self.node_count():
            self.append(data)
            return
        else:
            new_node = Node(data)
            current = self.head
            for i in range(position - 1):
                current = current.next
            next_node = current.next
            current.next = new_node
            next_node.prev = new_node
            new_node.prev = current
            new_node.next = next_node

    # 从头开始删除
    def delete_from_beginning(self):
        if self.is_empty():
            print('Cannot delete from Empty')
        elif self.node_count() == 1:
            temp = self.head
            self.head = None
            self.tail = None
            del temp
        else: 
            current = self.head
            self.head = self.head.next
            self.head.prev = None
            del current
    
    # 从末尾删除
    def delete_from_end(self):
        if self.is_empty():
            print('Cannot delete from Empty')
        elif self.node_count() == 1:
            temp = self.head
            self.head = None
            self.tail = None
            del temp
        else: 
            current = self.tail
            self.tail = self.tail.prev
            self.tail.next = None
            del current

    # 从给定位置删除
    def delete_from_position(self, position):
        if self.is_empty():
            print('Cannot delete from Empty')  
        elif position <= 0 or position > self.node_count():
            print('Invalid position')
        elif position == 1:
            self.delete_from_beginning()
        elif position == self.node_count():
            self.delete_from_end()
        else:
            current = self.head
            prev_node = next_node = None
            for i in range(position-1):
                current = current.next
            prev_node = current.prev
            next_node = current.next
            prev_node.next = next_node
            next_node.prev = prev_node
            del current

    # 反转
    def reverse(self):
        
        # 在0或1结点的情况下无需反转
        if self.node_count() < 2:
            return
        
        # 从头开始
        current = self.head
        while True:
            # 交换结点的prev指针和next指针
            current.prev, current.next = current.next, current.prev
            
            # 移动到新的前一个结点
            current = current.prev
            
            # 重复，直到current为None
            if current == None:
                break
            
        # 交换头结点和尾结点
        self.head, self.tail = self.tail, self.head

# 检查链表是否为回文
def is_palindrome(self):
    # 回文不适用于空链表
    if self.is_empty():
        return False
    
    # 获取头结点和尾结点的引用
    start = self.head
    end = self.tail

    while start != end and start.prev != end:
        # 如果数据不匹配，则返回False
        if start.data != end.data:
            return False
        # 从头结点向后移动，从尾结点向前移动
        start = start.next
        end = end.prev
        # 重复直到end不是在start之后
        if(start == end or start == end.next):
            return True

class Node:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.prev = None
        self.data = data
        self.next = None

class DoublyLinkedList:
    def __init__(self):
        self.head = None
        self.tail = None

    # 遍历链表
    def traverse(self):
        current = self.head
        print("None", end = " <-> ")
        while current is not None:
            print(f"{current.data} <-> ", end="") 
            current = current.next
        print("None")

    # 反向遍历链表
    def reverse_traverse(self):
        current = self.tail
        print("None", end = " <-> ")
        while current is not None:
            print(f"{current.data} <-> ", end="") 
            current = current.prev
        print("None")
    # 节点计数
    def node_count(self):
        current = self.head
        count = 0
        while current is not None:
            count += 1
            current = current.next
        return count

    # 检查是否为空
    def is_empty(self):
        return self.head == None

    # 添加到空列表
    def append_to_empty(self, data):
        new_node = Node(data)
        self.head = new_node
        self.tail = new_node

    # 在末尾插入(追加)
    def append(self, data):
        if self.is_empty():
            self.append_to_empty(data)
            return
        new_node = Node(data)
        new_node.prev = self.tail
        self.tail.next = new_node
        self.tail = new_node
    
    # 在开始处插入
    def insert_at_beginning(self, data):
        if self.is_empty():
            self.append_to_empty()
            return
        new_node = Node(data)
        new_node.next = self.head
        self.head.prev = new_node
        self.head = new_node
    
    # 在指定位置插入
    def insert_at_position(self, position, data):
        if position < 0 or position > self.node_count():
            print("Invalid position")
            return
        elif position == 0:
            self.insert_at_beginning(data)
            return
        elif position == self.node_count():
            self.append(data)
            return
        else:
            new_node = Node(data)
            current = self.head
            for i in range(position - 1):
                current = current.next
            next_node = current.next
            current.next = new_node
            next_node.prev = new_node
            new_node.prev = current
            new_node.next = next_node

    # 从开始处删除
    def delete_from_beginning(self):
        if self.is_empty():
            print('Cannot delete from Empty')
        elif self.node_count() == 1:
            temp = self.head
            self.head = None
            self.tail = None
            del temp
        else: 
            current = self.head
            self.head = self.head.next
            self.head.prev = None
            del current
    
    # 从末尾删除
    def delete_from_end(self):
        if self.is_empty():
            print('Cannot delete from Empty')
        elif self.node_count() == 1:
            temp = self.head
            self.head = None
            self.tail = None
            del temp
        else: 
            current = self.tail
            self.tail = self.tail.prev
            self.tail.next = None
            del current

    # 从给定位置删除
    def delete_from_position(self, position):
        if self.is_empty():
            print('Cannot delete from Empty')  
        elif position <= 0 or position > self.node_count():
            print('Invalid position')
        elif position == 1:
            self.delete_from_beginning()
        elif position == self.node_count():
            self.delete_from_end()
        else:
            current = self.head
            prev_node = next_node = None
            for i in range(position-1):
                current = current.next
            prev_node = current.prev
            next_node = current.next
            prev_node.next = next_node
            next_node.prev = prev_node
            del current

    # 检查回文
    def is_palindrome(self):
        # 空链表不适用于回文
        if self.is_empty():
            return False
        
        # 获取头和尾的引用
        start = self.head
        end = self.tail

        while True:
            # 如果数据不匹配，返回False
            if start.data != end.data:
                return False
            # 从头部向前移动，从尾部向后移动
            start = start.next
            end = end.prev
            # 重复直到end不再在start之后
            if(start == end or start == end.next):
                return True
